description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the daily coordination-cell roster for two partner-unit liaison periods and assign the remaining specialist as the alternate, while recording the confirmations needed to keep both periods staffed.

shared_context.S1: The coordination cell has three available personnel for today's roster: Spc. Rowan, Cpl. Ito, and Sgt. Malik.
shared_context.S2: The cell must cover an 0800-1000 partner liaison period and a 1300-1500 secure-network coordination period, with one person designated as the alternate for both periods.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Hart publishes the binding daily roster, and each assigned person can cover only one of the two primary periods.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's daily synchronization review routinely includes the personnel readiness and signal representatives before the S-3 publishes the roster.
shared_context.S5: The roster must include a confirmation that each assigned person meets the requirements of the period assigned.
shared_context.S6: Maj. Hart records the exact period strings 0800-1000 and 1300-1500 and the applicable qualification confirmations in the published roster.

PF1.text: SFC Alvarez confirmed this morning that Spc. Rowan's current host-nation liaison credential is valid for the 0800-1000 partner period, and Rowan is the only person on today's list with that credential; the renewal entry is still pending on the personnel roster.

PF2.text: Lt. Brooks confirmed that Cpl. Ito completed the current secure-network access recertification and is the only person on today's list authorized for the 1300-1500 coordination period; the updated access record has not yet been added to the operations briefing slide.

acceptance_conditions: Spc. Rowan must be assigned to the 0800-1000 partner liaison period.
Cpl. Ito must be assigned to the 1300-1500 secure-network coordination period.
Sgt. Malik must be designated as the alternate.
The roster must record the morning period as 0800-1000.
The roster must record the secure-network period as 1300-1500.
A credential confirmation commitment for the morning assignee must be recorded.
A secure-network access confirmation commitment for the afternoon assignee must be recorded.
The host-nation liaison credential fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any('Rowan' in c['detail'] and 'credential' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('Ito' in c['detail'] and ('recertification' in c['detail'] or 'access' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The current credential changes the morning assignee to exactly Spc. Rowan, requires a commitment identifying Rowan's credential, and requires PF1 to be spoken aloud and cited in the justification.

The current access recertification changes the secure-network assignee to exactly Cpl. Ito, leaves Sgt. Malik as the alternate, requires a commitment identifying Ito's access, and requires PF2 to be spoken aloud and cited in the justification.
